title: HODGE-DISPROOF: Dependent Type-Theoretic Schema and 31-Module Lean 4 Audit Framework for Rational Hodge Counterexample Candidates
description: Standalone 31-module Lean 4 formalization (`Hodge/*.lean`, `Main.lean`, `EVIDENCE_LEDGER.md`) specifying the exact dependent type-theoretic signature (D_bad, gamma_bad, forall z, cl(z) = gamma_bad -> False) required for any putative counterexample to the rational Hodge Conjecture, together with automated audit checks tracking which candidate geometric inputs are inhabited vs. open. Formalizes the type-theoretic verification schema and audit ledger for testing candidate counterexamples in Lean 4; explicitly records Clay status as OPEN and does not claim an inhabited unconditional disproof.
